axis: studio = (-x, z, y) of blender; Blender front -Y = Studio front -Z
units: studs; the model is at final size, import 1:1 and do not scale
sides: L/R are the chicken's own left/right; its left is Blender +X = Studio -X
origin: all positions are relative to the model origin = ground point (Blender world origin): the hip-line centre dropped to the feet bottom
texture_note: one shared atlas; every MeshPart uses the same TextureID
body_pivot_convention: Chicken_Body pivot = centre of the hip line (not the body bbox centre)
rest_rotation: every part has identity rotation relative to the model at rest
overall_scope: overall_size / overall_center / ground_point cover the six rig parts only
feather_note: Chicken_Feather (kind 'feather') is a standalone burst piece exported beside the chicken; do not weld or Motor6D it to the rig. Origin = its bbox centre; length along Studio Z (quill end toward -Z, tip toward +Z), width along X, thickness along Y (lies flat at rest)

Chicken_Body.pivot_is: hip-line centre (the root part; waddle/bob pivot)
Chicken_Body.suggested_motion: root part; waddle = small roll about Studio Z (front-back) and bob in Studio Y

Chicken_Head.suggested_motion: peck = pitch about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the neck point

Chicken_WingL.pivot_is: top-front shoulder hinge (flap about the front-back axis)
Chicken_WingL.suggested_motion: flap = rotate about Studio Z (front-back axis) through the shoulder hinge, tip swinging out/up

Chicken_WingR.pivot_is: top-front shoulder hinge (flap about the front-back axis)
Chicken_WingR.suggested_motion: flap = rotate about Studio Z (front-back axis) through the shoulder hinge, tip swinging out/up

Chicken_LegL.pivot_is: hip point at the body underside (swing about the side axis)
Chicken_LegL.suggested_motion: walk = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the hip point

Chicken_LegR.pivot_is: hip point at the body underside (swing about the side axis)
Chicken_LegR.suggested_motion: walk = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the hip point

Chicken_Feather.pivot_is: bbox centre (standalone burst piece, not part of the rig)
Chicken_Feather.suggested_motion: not part of the rig: clone it many times for the death 'pop' feather burst
